differences.a_observable: The 'Renewal Success' tile is positioned directly above the 'Secure Payments' tile.
differences.b_observable: The 'Renewal Success' tile is positioned to the right of the 'Secure Payments' tile.
differences.fix: Reposition the 'Renewal Success' tile to be directly above the 'Secure Payments' tile.

differences.a_observable: The yellow tile at the bottom of the frame exhibits a brushed metallic texture with anisotropic reflections.
differences.b_observable: The yellow tile is a flat, matte yellow plastic material with no texture or metallic reflections.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal material with anisotropic roughness to the yellow tiles.

differences.a_observable: The 'Renewal Success' tile at the top of the frame is out of focus due to depth-of-field blur.
differences.b_observable: The 'Renewal Success' tile is in sharp focus, indicating a lack of depth-of-field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and set the focus distance to the 'Secure Payments' tile.

differences.a_observable: Soft, dark contact shadows are visible beneath the 'Subscriptions', 'Retries', and 'APMs' tiles.
differences.b_observable: The contact shadows beneath the tiles are extremely faint and barely visible.
differences.fix: Adjust the light source or shadow settings to produce stronger, softer contact shadows under the tiles.

json.highest_impact_fix: Rearrange the tiles to match the reference layout and apply the brushed metallic material to the yellow tiles.
